apiVersion: helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2
kind: HelmRelease
metadata:
  name: elasticsearch
  namespace: observability-dev
spec:
  chart:
    spec:
      chart: ./infra/platform/charts/eck-elasticsearch-0.20.0.tgz
      sourceRef:
        kind: GitRepository
        name: puni-platform
        namespace: flux-system
      version: 0.20.0
  dependsOn:
    - name: eck-operator
      namespace: observability
  interval: 30m
  values:
    auth:
      fileRealm:
        - secretName: signal-health-users
        - secretName: signal-ingest-users
      roles:
        - secretName: signal-health-roles
        - secretName: signal-ingest-roles
    fullnameOverride: elasticsearch
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:9.3.8@sha256:f96812864b81e62a9ce7562c4f4bbef1186bb4e8798f814bc6a5f2b84b51b540
    nodeSets:
      - config:
          node.store.allow_mmap: false
          s3.client.default.endpoint: object-store.puni-backup.svc:9000
          s3.client.default.path_style_access: true
          s3.client.default.protocol: https
        count: 1
        name: default
        podTemplate:
          spec:
            containers:
              - env:
                  - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                    value: -Xms1g -Xmx1g
                name: elasticsearch
                resources:
                  limits:
                    cpu: "2"
                    ephemeral-storage: 1Gi
                    memory: 2Gi
                  requests:
                    cpu: 500m
                    ephemeral-storage: 1Gi
                    memory: 2Gi
                securityContext:
                  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                  capabilities:
                    drop:
                      - ALL
                volumeMounts:
                  - mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust
                    name: s3-trust
                    readOnly: true
                  - mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/jvm.options.d/s3.options
                    name: s3-trust
                    readOnly: true
                    subPath: s3.options
            initContainers:
              - command:
                  - bash
                  - -ec
                  - |
                    # Proof: replacing this copy with touch accepted missing/unreadable bundled roots (backup-tls.test.ts).
                    cp "/usr/share/elasticsearch/jdk/lib/security/cacerts" /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust/cacerts
                    chmod u+w /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust/cacerts
                    case "$S3_TRUST_MODE" in
                      system-roots) ;;
                      system-roots-plus-ca)
                        # Proof: each removed file guard lost its distinct CA refusal (backup-tls.test.ts).
                        path=/s3-credentials/ca.crt
                        [ -e "$path" ] || { echo "missing TLS input: $path" >&2; exit 1; }
                        [ -r "$path" ] || { echo "unreadable TLS input: $path" >&2; exit 1; }
                        [ -s "$path" ] || { echo "empty TLS input: $path" >&2; exit 1; }
                        # Proof: removing the parse refusal lost the malformed-CA diagnostic (backup-tls.test.ts).
                        "/usr/share/elasticsearch/jdk/bin/keytool" -printcert -file "$path" >/dev/null || { echo "malformed TLS input: $path" >&2; exit 1; }
                        "/usr/share/elasticsearch/jdk/bin/keytool" -importcert -noprompt -alias puni-s3-ca -file "$path" -keystore /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust/cacerts -storepass changeit
                        ;;
                      # Proof: removing this branch accepted the unknown trust mode (backup-tls.test.ts).
                      *) echo "invalid S3_TRUST_MODE" >&2; exit 1 ;;
                    esac
                    printf '%s\n' '-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore=/usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust/cacerts' '-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStorePassword=changeit' > /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust/s3.options
                env:
                  - name: S3_TRUST_MODE
                    value: system-roots-plus-ca
                image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:9.3.8@sha256:f96812864b81e62a9ce7562c4f4bbef1186bb4e8798f814bc6a5f2b84b51b540
                name: prepare-s3-trust
                resources:
                  limits:
                    cpu: 500m
                    ephemeral-storage: 64Mi
                    memory: 256Mi
                  requests:
                    cpu: 100m
                    ephemeral-storage: 64Mi
                    memory: 128Mi
                securityContext:
                  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                  capabilities:
                    drop:
                      - ALL
                  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
                volumeMounts:
                  - mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust
                    name: s3-trust
                  - mountPath: /s3-credentials
                    name: s3-credentials
                    readOnly: true
              - name: elastic-internal-init-filesystem
                resources:
                  limits:
                    cpu: 100m
                    ephemeral-storage: 64Mi
                    memory: 50Mi
                  requests:
                    cpu: 100m
                    ephemeral-storage: 64Mi
                    memory: 50Mi
              - name: elastic-internal-init-keystore
                resources:
                  limits:
                    cpu: 500m
                    ephemeral-storage: 64Mi
                    memory: 196Mi
                  requests:
                    cpu: 500m
                    ephemeral-storage: 64Mi
                    memory: 196Mi
              - name: elastic-internal-suspend
                resources:
                  limits:
                    cpu: "2"
                    ephemeral-storage: 1Gi
                    memory: 2Gi
                  requests:
                    cpu: 500m
                    ephemeral-storage: 1Gi
                    memory: 2Gi
            nodeSelector:
              puni.dev/capability-observability: "true"
            securityContext:
              fsGroup: 1000
              runAsGroup: 1000
              runAsNonRoot: true
              runAsUser: 1000
              seccompProfile:
                type: RuntimeDefault
            volumes:
              - emptyDir:
                  sizeLimit: 16Mi
                name: s3-trust
              - name: s3-credentials
                secret:
                  defaultMode: 292
                  secretName: elastic-s3-credentials
              - emptyDir:
                  sizeLimit: 16Mi
                name: elastic-internal-elasticsearch-bin-local
              - emptyDir:
                  sizeLimit: 16Mi
                name: elastic-internal-elasticsearch-config-local
              - emptyDir:
                  sizeLimit: 16Mi
                name: elastic-internal-elasticsearch-plugins-local
              - emptyDir:
                  sizeLimit: 256Mi
                name: elasticsearch-logs
              - emptyDir:
                  sizeLimit: 256Mi
                name: tmp-volume
        volumeClaimTemplates:
          - metadata:
              name: elasticsearch-data
            spec:
              accessModes:
                - ReadWriteOnce
              resources:
                requests:
                  storage: 10Gi
              storageClassName: puni-retain
    secureSettings:
      - entries:
          - key: s3.client.default.access_key
          - key: s3.client.default.secret_key
        secretName: elastic-s3-credentials
    version: 9.3.8
    volumeClaimDeletePolicy: DeleteOnScaledownOnly

    fullnameOverride: elasticsearch

    nodeSets:
      - config:
          node.store.allow_mmap: false
          s3.client.default.endpoint: object-store.puni-backup.svc:9000
          s3.client.default.path_style_access: true
          s3.client.default.protocol: https
        count: 1
        name: default
        podTemplate:
          spec:
            containers:
              - env:
                  - name: ES_JAVA_OPTS
                    value: -Xms1g -Xmx1g
                name: elasticsearch
                resources:
                  limits:
                    cpu: "2"
                    ephemeral-storage: 1Gi
                    memory: 2Gi
                  requests:
                    cpu: 500m
                    ephemeral-storage: 1Gi
                    memory: 2Gi
                securityContext:
                  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                  capabilities:
                    drop:
                      - ALL
                volumeMounts:
                  - mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust
                    name: s3-trust

                  - mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/jvm.options.d/s3.options
                    name: s3-trust
                    readOnly: true
                    subPath: s3.options
            initContainers:
              - command:
                  - bash
                  - -ec
                  - |
                    # Proof: replacing this copy with touch accepted missing/unreadable bundled roots (backup-tls.test.ts).
                    cp "/usr/share/elasticsearch/jdk/lib/security/cacerts" /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust/cacerts
                    chmod u+w /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust/cacerts
                    case "$S3_TRUST_MODE" in
                      system-roots) ;;
                      system-roots-plus-ca)
                        # Proof: each removed file guard lost its distinct CA refusal (backup-tls.test.ts).
                        path=/s3-credentials/ca.crt
                        [ -e "$path" ] || { echo "missing TLS input: $path" >&2; exit 1; }
                        [ -r "$path" ] || { echo "unreadable TLS input: $path" >&2; exit 1; }
                        [ -s "$path" ] || { echo "empty TLS input: $path" >&2; exit 1; }
                        # Proof: removing the parse refusal lost the malformed-CA diagnostic (backup-tls.test.ts).
                        "/usr/share/elasticsearch/jdk/bin/keytool" -printcert -file "$path" >/dev/null || { echo "malformed TLS input: $path" >&2; exit 1; }
                        "/usr/share/elasticsearch/jdk/bin/keytool" -importcert -noprompt -alias puni-s3-ca -file "$path" -keystore /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust/cacerts -storepass changeit
                        ;;
                      # Proof: removing this branch accepted the unknown trust mode (backup-tls.test.ts).
                      *) echo "invalid S3_TRUST_MODE" >&2; exit 1 ;;
                    esac
                    printf '%s\n' '-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore=/usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust/cacerts' '-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStorePassword=changeit' > /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust/s3.options
                env:
                  - name: S3_TRUST_MODE
                    value: system-roots-plus-ca
                image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:9.3.8@sha256:f96812864b81e62a9ce7562c4f4bbef1186bb4e8798f814bc6a5f2b84b51b540
                name: prepare-s3-trust
                resources:
                  limits:
                    cpu: 500m
                    ephemeral-storage: 64Mi
                    memory: 256Mi
                  requests:
                    cpu: 100m
                    ephemeral-storage: 64Mi
                    memory: 128Mi
                securityContext:
                  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
                  capabilities:
                    drop:
                      - ALL
                  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
                volumeMounts:
                  - mountPath: /usr/share/elasticsearch/config/s3-trust
                    name: s3-trust
                  - mountPath: /s3-credentials
                    name: s3-credentials
                    readOnly: true
              - name: elastic-internal-init-filesystem
                resources:
                  limits:

                  requests:

                    memory: 2Gi
            nodeSelector:

            securityContext:
              fsGroup: 1000
              runAsGroup: 1000
              runAsNonRoot: true
              runAsUser: 1000
              seccompProfile:
                type: RuntimeDefault
            volumes:
              - emptyDir:

                  sizeLimit: 16Mi

              - emptyDir:
                  sizeLimit: 256Mi
                name: elasticsearch-logs
              - emptyDir:
                  sizeLimit: 256Mi
                name: tmp-volume
        volumeClaimTemplates:
          - metadata:
              name: elasticsearch-data
            spec:
              accessModes:
                - ReadWriteOnce
              resources:
                requests:
                  storage: 10Gi
              storageClassName: puni-retain
    secureSettings:
      - entries:
          - key: s3.client.default.access_key
          - key: s3.client.default.secret_key
        secretName: elastic-s3-credentials
    version: 9.3.8
    volumeClaimDeletePolicy: DeleteOnScaledownOnly
